name: The front office (Knightsbrook International School), evaluation room 4: the second test room, "Back in Five Minutes"
setting: Cosy, warm and tidy: the small front office of a Singapore international primary school at ten past three on the last afternoon of term, with an afternoon rainstorm outside, empty of people.
palette: the walls are warm white above a pale teal painted band; the band's top edge is at a child's shoulder height, 42% of the way up the back wall from the floor; the floor is a soft grey carpet; the counter and furniture are pale birch wood with white tops; accents teal and a warm mustard yellow; brass on the hooks
box: a shallow box in one-point perspective: a wide back wall running the full width, narrow side walls, a thin strip of ceiling, a low floor band
light: the only daylight comes through the window beside the doorway on the entrance wall, a soft grey rainy-afternoon light, with warm even light from the ceiling elsewhere

o1.name: the counter wall (north)
o1.light: soft daylight comes from behind the viewer (the window is on the opposite wall), so the counter's front is lit evenly and faint shadows fall straight back under its top; the ceiling light warms the pigeonholes

objects.label: reception counter with a hinged flap
objects.text: a long reception counter in pale birch with a white top and a hinged flap at its right-hand end; one shallow drawer with a small round wooden knob under the top at the left; on the counter top, at the left, an open visitors' book with a pen on a short string, and nothing else
objects.size: the counter top at a grown-up's waist, a little above the top of the painted band

objects.label: wall of pigeonholes
objects.text: behind the counter, a wall-mounted grid of twelve wooden pigeonholes, three rows of four, most holding a few plain envelopes and papers, every label slot blank
objects.size: each hole a little bigger than an envelope

objects.label: the middle of the counter top
objects.text: on the middle of the counter top, a folded note, a brass counter bell and a small sign on a stand
objects.moves: single (the note: lift; the bell: pop; the sign: wobble)
objects.absent: the middle of the counter top is bare, nothing standing on it
objects.cut: three things, each drawn alone: a folded sheet of cream notepaper with nothing written on it; a round brass counter bell with a button on top; a small white sign on a short stand with a blank face

objects.label: office chair with a cardigan
objects.text: behind the counter at the right, the top of a grey office chair showing above the counter, a soft mustard-yellow cardigan draped over its back
objects.size: its back a little above the counter top

o2.name: the head's-door wall (east), to the right of the counter wall
o2.light: the window is to the right and behind, so a soft grey light comes from the right and shadows lean gently left; the ceiling light keeps the wall warm

objects.label: the head's door, closed
objects.text: a closed pale wooden door with a large panel of frosted glass in its upper half and a brass handle, nothing written on the glass
objects.size: the door reaches almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: round wall clock
objects.text: a round white wall clock with a plain blank face and no hands, above and to the right of the door
objects.size: the clock the width of two hands

objects.label: low filing cabinet with an answering machine on top
objects.text: a low two-drawer grey filing cabinet, and on its top a small cream answering machine with a blank dark display strip and one large round button, no lead attached to it; on the wall beside the cabinet, at the height of the band, a single white electric socket with nothing plugged in
objects.size: the cabinet top level with the top of the band

objects.label: staff board with six empty frames
objects.text: a framed board on the wall at the right, with six small empty photograph frames in two rows of three and a blank label slot under each, nothing in any frame
objects.size: each frame the size of a postcard

o3.name: the entrance wall (south), opposite the counter wall
o3.light: grey rainy daylight comes through the window at the left of this wall and lies in a soft pale patch on the carpet below it; the open doorway in the middle shows the corridor beyond, lit the same grey; the rest of the wall is warm from the ceiling light

objects.label: window with rain
objects.text: a window with a white frame, rain streaming down the glass, showing a covered school walkway and dark green trees in heavy rain beyond
objects.size: its sill at the top of the band

objects.label: open doorway to the corridor
objects.text: a wide open doorway in the middle of the wall with no door in it, and through it a glimpse of a school corridor: cream wall, a strip of mint band, a row of lockers
objects.size: the doorway reaches almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: old wall telephone with a dial
objects.text: an old-fashioned cream wall telephone with a round dial that has no numbers on it and a handset resting on its hook, mounted on the wall to the right of the doorway at a grown-up's shoulder height
objects.size: the handset the length of a hand and a half

objects.label: a small gecko high on the wall
objects.text: a small pale house gecko on the wall above the telephone
objects.moves: single (hop, then it slips out of sight)
objects.absent: the wall above the telephone is plain and empty
objects.cut: a small pale house gecko, seen from above as it clings to a wall, head up, tail curled a little

objects.label: wooden bench
objects.text: a low pale birch bench with nothing on it, against the wall under the telephone
objects.size: its seat at a child's knee

objects.label: water cooler
objects.text: a white water cooler with a clear blue bottle on top, standing at the far right
objects.size: as tall as a grown-up's chest

o4.name: the cupboard wall (west), to the left of the counter wall
o4.light: the window is to the left and behind, so a soft grey light comes from the left and shadows lean gently right; the ceiling light keeps the wall warm

objects.label: photocopier
objects.text: a large cream photocopier with its flat lid closed, a small blank control panel on its top edge, standing against the wall at the left
objects.size: its top at a grown-up's waist, level with the top of the band

objects.label: tall post cupboard with a keypad
objects.text: a tall cupboard painted sage green with a single door, closed, and a small white keypad panel on the door at a grown-up's chest height with ten blank buttons in three rows and one green button below; the cupboard top reaches almost to the ceiling strip
objects.size: reaching almost to the ceiling strip

objects.label: potted palm
objects.text: a potted palm in a plain terracotta pot standing on the carpet
objects.absent: bare grey carpet at the right, where a pot plant will stand: nothing there
objects.cut: a potted palm with five or six arching fronds in a plain terracotta pot
objects.size: as tall as a grown-up's shoulder

objects.label: shelf of lost umbrellas
objects.text: a short wooden shelf on the wall at the right with four folded umbrellas on it in different plain colours, a small blank label slot on the shelf's edge
objects.size: the shelf at a grown-up's eye height
